SURIYA PRAKASH R M 
 Phone: +91 6383191041 | E-mail: suriyaprakash.rm2024aids@sece.ac.in | LinkedIn | GitHub | Self Intro | Portfolio 
Education 
B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science CGPA: 8.57/10 
Sri Eshwar College of Engineering, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 2024 – 2028 
Oxaliss International CBSE School, HSC (Class XII) — 92.2% 2023 – 2024 
Oxaliss International CBSE School, SSLC (Class X) — 96.4% 2021 – 2022 
Experience 
Infoziant — MERN Stack Developer Intern (Internship) 
- Engineered full-stack web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), building 15+ reusable React 
components that improved development velocity and UI consistency across the platform. 
- Designed and integrated RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.js and modeled optimized MongoDB schemas with efficient CRUD 
operations to support scalable, high-performance application data management. 
Projects 
DrivePortz — AI-Powered Mobility Digital Twin Platform | React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas Freelance Project 
- Developed a full-stack MERN Mobility Digital Twin platform for end-to-end vehicle lifecycle management (service, insurance, ownership, 
maintenance), featuring Vehicle Passport — a QR-based digital vehicle identity with Cloudinary-backed cloud storage for verified records. 
- Built role-based authentication for Users, Garages, and Administrators using JWT and bcrypt with OTP-based recovery, plus a 
geolocation Garage Marketplace (Google Maps API) and an admin analytics dashboard for users, garages, and revenue insights. 
- Engineered Gemini AI features — an AI Vehicle Doctor for diagnostics (probable causes, repair-cost estimates, urgency levels) and a 
multi-agent CoPilot Assistant for personalized insights and emergency roadside assistance. 
Trackit — Smart Product Inventory System (Gen AI) | Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Python, Flask, MongoDB 
- Engineered a full-stack smart inventory platform with role-based access control for administrators and customers using Next.js, Flask, and 
MongoDB, enabling secure multi-user workflows. 
- Implemented product entry via manual input and QR-code scanning with automated expiry-date tracking and reminders, cutting manual 
stock-monitoring effort. 
- Built predictive analytics to forecast product demand from historical sales data and designed data-driven dashboards for purchase and 
inventory insights. 
Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) System | Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, EasyOCR, Flask, MongoDB 
- Developed a real-time ANPR system using YOLOv8 for number-plate detection and EasyOCR for text extraction, processing live video 
feeds with OpenCV and persisting recognized plates in MongoDB. 
- Validated detection accuracy through train/test evaluation and manual review of edge cases (low-light, partially obscured plates) to 
improve real-world robustness. 
- Implemented an efficient search-and-retrieval module for vehicle identification in surveillance and access-control use cases. 
SepsisSense — Sepsis Detection & Early Warning System | Python, Machine Learning, Pandas, NumPy, Flask, Streamlit 
- Built a machine-learning sepsis-detection system to identify high-risk patients for timely clinical intervention, engineering features from 
patient vitals in the PhysioNet 2019 Challenge dataset (1.3M+ hourly ICU records, ~40,000 patients, two independent hospital systems). 
- Trained and evaluated multiple ML models for sepsis-risk classification, achieving 90% accuracy with a recall-focused approach validated 
via train/test split analysis and manual review of borderline cases. 
- Deployed a real-time clinical decision-support interface using Streamlit and Flask. 
Coding Profiles 
LeetCode: Solved 250+ data structures and algorithms problems | Contest Rating: 1613 
CodeChef: Solved 350+ competitive programming problems 
SkillRack: Solved 1100+ programming problems | Earned 310+ Bronze medals 
Honors & Achievements 
- PayPal Mentorship Program - Selected for industry mentorship from experienced software engineers on modern development practices 
and real-world engineering workflows. 
- Finalist, InnoHack Hackathon VIT University - Reached the finalist stage by building and pitching an innovative technology solution to a 
panel of industry experts. 
- Second Prize, Creatathon 2025 - Recognized for creativity, problem-solving, and engineering impact in project implementation. 
- Second Prize, Freshathon 2025 - Runner-up in an inter-college hackathon, delivering an innovative technical solution under strict time 
constraints. 
- Second Prize, Web Design Showdown 2025 - Awarded for excellence in UI/UX design and front-end development. 
Certifications 
- Python Programming G-TEC 2024 
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Corizo 2025 
- C and C++ Programming IIT Bombay 2025 
- Mastering DSA in C and C++ Udemy 2025 
- Design Thinking – A Primer NPTEL 2026 
Technical Skills 
Languages: C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL 
Frontend: React.js, Redux, Next.js, React Native, Tailwind CSS 
Backend: NestJS, Node.js, Spring Boot, Express.js, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, WebSockets 
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB 
DevOps & Tools: Git, Docker, Kafka, CI/CD, Vercel, Postman, Firebase 
CS Core: Data Structures & Algorithms, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, OOPs
